headline: Viviana Power Tech board approves up to Rs 150 crore fundraise through rights issue
hook: Capital raise via rights issue announced

modes.bear: A rights issue expands the equity base, diluting existing earnings per share.
modes.bull: Raising Rs 150 crore provides growth capital for expansion in the power sector.
modes.simple: The company is asking its current shareholders for more money to fund its business, which means you can either buy more shares or see your current holding's ownership percentage shrink a bit.

summary: Viviana Power Tech Limited announced that its board of directors met on November 21, 2026, and approved raising up to Rs 150 crore through a rights issue of equity shares. The capital infusion will increase the company's equity base. Existing shareholders will be offered rights shares to participate in the capital raise. Retail investors holding the stock should review the rights entitlement ratio and dilution impact.
whats_next: Rights issue record date and pricing announcement
why_it_matters: Existing shareholders face equity dilution or need to deploy fresh capital.

headline: Viviana Power Tech releases financial highlights for the half year ended September 30, 2026
hook: Half-year numbers out at Viviana Power
summary: Viviana Power Tech Limited has submitted a press release to the stock exchange detailing its financial performance for the first half of the 2026-27 financial year. The update covers the period ending September 30, 2026. Retail investors tracking the company can review the official filing for revenue, profit, and margin figures. These periodic disclosures help shareholders assess operational progress during the semi-annual cycle.
why_it_matters: Semi-annual financial data helps track Viviana Power's ongoing operational performance.
